review_scope_note: Independent AI sub-agent review completed; this is not external human peer review or institutional graduation approval.
intended_claim: The project supports reliable multi-region docking/navigation under table-layout changes and provides defensible master's-level mobile-manipulation research contributions.
what_results_support: Current-worktree four-table mixed-angle end-to-end geometric planning succeeds; prior October 28 default 16-table repair also succeeds.
Thirteen targeted tests and 4/8/16-table scene-build checks passed.
Sampled rectangular-footprint, endpoint and route-assembly checks support base-level geometric safety in tested cases.
Historical configurations show candidate-coverage recovery and cache-related computation savings.
what_results_dont_support: Physical IK, collision-free coordinated dual-arm trajectories or measured task completion.
Arbitrary layout-change success or online table-moving/rotation recovery.
General superiority of bidirectional planning or state-of-the-art mobile-manipulation performance.
missing_evidence: Current-version held-out layout matrix and fair strong baselines.
Validated bidirectional neighborhood behavior and demonstrable improvement.
Dynamic recovery success/failure and fallback-inclusive cost.
suggested_claim_revision: Coverage-constrained multi-docking selection and navigation for multi-region tabletop tasks in known geometric environments.
